title: Interactions between atmospheric CO2 concentration and phosphorus nutrition on the formation of proteoid roots in white lupin
notes: Table 1 reports total plant P content (mg/plant). Figure 4 reports tissue P concentration (% DW) for leaves, roots, proteoid roots. Only P is measured. Low CO2 = 200 umol/mol also tested but 410 is the ambient control. n=3 experiments.
